# ESG & Sustainability

> MENASCO is committed to Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles that guide how we design, build, and operate as a leading Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) contractor in the UAE. Our ESG philosophy centers on delivering sustainable engineering solutions that create long-term value for our clients, employees, communities, and the environment.

## Environmental

Sustainability is embedded into every stage of our project delivery, from planning and procurement through construction and facility handover. We prioritize energy-efficient engineering solutions, responsible material selection, and the efficient use of resources, while working continuously to reduce waste and environmental impact across our operations.

## Social

Our people are at the center of everything we do. MENASCO is committed to employee wellbeing, health and safety, and workforce development, supported by ongoing training and professional development. We foster a respectful, inclusive workplace culture that values diversity, and we extend that same commitment beyond our teams, engaging with the communities where we operate while building ethical, long-term partnerships with clients and suppliers alike.

## Governance

Responsible governance underpins how MENASCO conducts business. We hold ourselves to high standards of ethical conduct, transparency, and accountability, supported by robust compliance and risk management practices. This disciplined approach to corporate responsibility protects the long-term interests of our clients, employees, and partners, and helps ensure integrity is maintained across every project we deliver.

## Continuous Improvement

ESG is not a separate initiative at MENASCO; it is integrated into our long-term strategy. By embedding environmental, social, and governance principles into how we plan, build, and operate, we drive innovation, operational excellence, and sustainable growth, ensuring responsible project delivery across the UAE and the wider region.

## ESG Highlights

- Sustainable Engineering: Energy-efficient systems designed for long-term performance.
- Responsible Construction: Reduced waste and responsible material selection on every project.
- Employee Wellbeing: A safe, supportive workplace for every member of our team.
- Ethical Governance: Transparent, accountable business conduct at every level.
- Environmental Stewardship: Protecting the environments where we build and operate.
- Community Impact: Meaningful engagement with the communities we serve.
